title: SharePoint: Governance Reviews Dashboard for site owners
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned dashboard from existing lifecycle policies and leaves dashboard-specific defaults, controls and licensing open. The policy paths are supported; two need minor completion, not replacement.

claims.claim: Attestation policy scope is reached in the SharePoint admin center through Policies > Site lifecycle management > Site attestation policies > Open > Create a policy > Overview > Set policy scope.
claims.quote: Under Site attestation policies, select Open. Then select Create a policy. On the Overview page of Manage site attestation, review the information ... on the Set policy scope page, select one of the following options

claims.claim: Inactive policy scope is reached through Policies > Site lifecycle management > Inactive site policies > Open > + Create policy > Set policy scope.
claims.quote: Under Inactive site policies, select Open. Select + Create policy. Review the Manage inactive sites information, and then select Next. On the Set policy scope step, choose your policy scope option
claims.fix: Use 'Policies > Site lifecycle management > Inactive site policies > Open > + Create policy > Manage inactive sites > Set policy scope' in controls[2].ui.path and the rendered table, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/inactive-site-policy.

claims.claim: Policies > Site lifecycle management > Site ownership policies > Open > + Create policy opens the ownership wizard, where scope and ownership criteria can be configured.
claims.quote: Under Site ownership policies, select Open. Then, select + Create policy. On Manage ownership of sites ... On Set policy scope, choose your policy scope parameters ... On Configure policy, specify criteria for your policy
claims.fix: Complete controls[3].ui.path and the rendered table as 'Policies > Site lifecycle management > Site ownership policies > Open > + Create policy > Manage ownership of sites > Set policy scope > Configure policy', using https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/site-ownership-policy. The current route is correct but stops at the wizard entrance.
